source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A stable, fairly mild presentation with fairly little accompanying hemodynamic effect noted on assessment of the client","B":"An improvement in the client's overall cardiac output and blood pressure reflecting this particular clinical presentation over time","C":"A presentation essentially identical to a simple pneumothorax, without any features that would meaningfully set the two conditions apart","D":"Progressive air accumulation causing increasing pressure that compresses the heart and great vessels, leading to hemodynamic compromise, a true emergency"}}
source_row.rationale: A tension pneumothorax is distinguished by progressive air accumulation in the pleural space causing increasing pressure that compresses the heart and great vessels, leading to significant hemodynamic compromise, a true medical emergency requiring immediate intervention (needle decompression) distinct from the more stable presentation typical of a simple pneumothorax.
source_row.source_name: Emergency Medicine References — Tension Pneumothorax Recognition
